method_notes: No rows deleted. Closure status applies to exact Maps profile, not every brand outlet in a mall.
Opening-hours labels are provider listings, not field-confirmation of active operation.
Actual closure dates are unknown unless dated evidence is explicitly supplied. Retrieval date is not a closure date.
Source absence, dated pop-up names, temporary closure and ordinary daily Closed-hours labels never become permanent closure automatically.
Status and geometry evidence are separate; a closed profile can carry an incorrect or historical point.
No cloud edits made by this audit. Parent must reconcile identity and preserve raw observations when integrating.

identity_exceptions.issue: Chanel fashion boutique vs beauty POS
identity_exceptions.decision: Permanent flag applies to exact Emsphere M Floor Unit MT41 fashion boutique Maps listing. Do not propagate to separately sourced CHANEL beauty Emsphere POS.

identity_exceptions.issue: Miu Miu former or incorrect Maps listing; geometry outside host
identity_exceptions.decision: Exact legacy Maps profile is permanently closed, but geometry is west of Siam Paragon. Preserve legacy observation; do not infer closure of any independently sourced current Miu Miu boutique.
Closed listing explicitly Bally Men’s Department Siam Paragon, floor2. Do not merge its status into another Bally POS solely on brand and mall.
Exact linked Maps store is EmQuartier, permanently closed. Store name, point and observed venue agree. Keep original venue as raw evidence and correct selected venue to EmQuartier.
Permanently closed listing is Patek Philippe by TKI at Siam Paragon, Unit M37. Do not propagate to PMT The Hour Glass Siam Paragon or merge them.

identity_exceptions.issue: Clé de Peau former counter identity
identity_exceptions.decision: Closed linked profile specifies2nd Floor Helix Quartier. Do not infer closure of independently sourced counters at another floor/unit.
Closed linked profile specifies1st Floor Paragon Department Store. Keep it distinct from any independently sourced replacement boutique.
Exact legacy link points Suvarnabhumi Airport (13.6916589,100.7495665). Do not attach point/status to Rangnam. Resolve possible duplicate with legacy343 and current airport record.
Exact linked Maps profile has Zen Ratchadamri address, located in centralwOrld. Do not attach to Siam Paragon or infer a relocation without further evidence.
